edge:us-frontier-act|us-preempt.note: EO 14365 §1 calls for working with Congress on a 'minimally burdensome national standard' and §8 for a legislative recommendation preempting conflicting state AI laws while sparing child-safety and state-procurement laws; H.R. 9925 §9 is a preemptive federal framework with matching carve-outs (minors, state procurement). entry:eu-aia:context.note: OJ text: 10^25 presumption (Art. 51(2)); evaluations incl. adversarial testing, serious-incident reporting and cybersecurity for systemic-risk GPAI (Art. 55(1)(a),(c),(d)); the Digital Omnibus does not amend Arts. 51 or 93. SB 53's frontier tier starts at 10^26 (S-0150#2), so every model above California's line is above the EU's, and models between 10^25 and 10^26 are covered only in the EU — the comparison follows from the thresholds. Prohibited practices, high-risk conformity assessment, FRIA and registration were verified at baseline (S-0002) and not re-quoted.
